name: Canonical PGlite Schema
description: Design the canonical PGlite schema for campaigns, missions, lanes, tasks, receipts, checkpoints, and memory links. Include constraints, indices, and migrations.
purpose: The destination schema is complete and reviewed before migration begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Each entity type has a complete PGlite table definition
All constraints (PK, FK, UNIQUE, CHECK, NOT NULL) are specified
All indexes are specified with columns and types
Migration SQL files are versioned and reviewed
Schema is peer-reviewed before implementation begins
